law: Serialize hard authority; classify moving-base impact; never mint project state, priority, permission, or a second owner.

hard_domains.reason: Global public identity/return registries must serialize.
FIELD root and its shared carrier are one mutable runtime boundary.

enforcement.note: Without branch protection/ruleset-required checks, this workflow is advisory even when it fails.

notes: A stale candidate touching hard authority fails and must rejoin the current base.
For ordinary candidates, base movement is classified: exact-file or hard-domain impact fails; unrelated movement warns.
GitHub pull_request checks execute against a synthetic merge ref; base drift is not by itself candidate causation.
Soft-domain overlap is a review signal only; native hosts may contain independent deltas.
Unique receipts and confluence notes do not collide merely because they share a directory.
This guard does not replace native tests, CURRENT, repository rulesets, or human release authority.
